_comment: Shared cross-language vector for the attestation signing preimage. Inputs are fixed; each implementation records what it computes. The stream position uses DIFFERENT values for txIndex and logIndex on purpose: equal values would let a packing that swapped the two fields pass.
_signing_comment: A fixed test-only key so the signature is reproducible. The producing side signs; the consuming side verifies. That is the loop the two halves of the preimage cannot check on their own: agreement on what to hash says nothing about agreement on the signature's encoding, the recovery id, or the low-s rule.
